pageHeader.title: In-Game Chat
pageHeader.description: Broadcast messages to all connected players and see their chat in real time.

emptyState.title: No chat messages yet
emptyState.description: Player messages and your broadcasts will appear here in real time.

channel.tip: Server broadcast shows a banner every player sees immediately. Admin chat is visible only to other admins — players never see it. General chat posts a normal-looking message from "{{adminLabel}}" into everyone's regular chat, easy to miss and indistinguishable from a real player named {{adminLabel}}.

deliveryStatus.rconFallback: Chat delivery: RCON fallback (native chat API unavailable)

input.noPermission: You don't have permission to send chat messages.

footer.adminOnly: Admins only — hidden from regular players
footer.noPlayersOnline: No players online — server log only

bridgeOffline.title: PanelBridge isn't running
bridgeOffline.description: Server broadcasts can't be sent. Admin and general chat go out over RCON as a plain message every player sees.

quickBroadcasts.label: Quick broadcasts
quickBroadcasts.description: One list for the whole panel: every admin sees the same presets. Pick one to put it in the message box.
quickBroadcasts.noPresets: No quick broadcasts yet. Select Edit to add one.
quickBroadcasts.deleteConfirmDescription: "{{preset}}" is shared -- every admin who uses quick broadcasts loses it too. You can always re-add it.
quickBroadcasts.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage quick broadcasts.

toasts.generalSentDesc: Posted into the public chat stream.
toasts.broadcastSentDesc: Message delivered to all connected players.
